Get into {target}'s depot at {system}, take what you can carry, and leave.

Package for the locker

Locker closed, key posted. {faction} pays {reward}.
The package is gone from the locker and {faction} is fatter by {reward}.
failure: The locker at {destination} was already open. {faction} pays nothing, and quietly changes every code it owns.
The package was opened in transit, and {faction} suspects you, though it can't prove it.
You were followed to the drop. {faction} won't use that locker again, and won't use you.
Late, and loudly so. {faction} pays nothing.
job: Take this sealed packet to locker 44 at {destination}. Don't open it, don't dawdle.
Carry the sealed data to the drop at {destination} and leave it where I tell you.
Deliver this package to a locker at {destination}, and then forget it ever existed.
Run this packet from {system} to {destination}, leaving it at the dock office under another name.
rules: No messages and no receipts. That's what you're being paid for.
If a warden asks, it's a birthday gift for your aunt.
Keep it in your own cabin. Nobody ever searches there, which is why I ask.
The less you know, the safer the whole chain.

Come inside
You've been noticed

success: The people who sent you smile with every tooth. {faction} pays {reward} and adds a second name to the guest list.
The {cargo} is accepted by someone who doesn't exist. {faction} pays {reward}, and the door opens a little wider.
{reward} from {faction}, and a handshake that means more than the money.
{faction} pays {reward}. You are now in the room, which was the actual payment.
failure: The {cargo} was lost, and a door that opened for you will now stay shut.
{faction} pays nothing and strikes your name from a list you didn't know you were on.
You were seen, which was the one thing you were told not to be. {faction} is polite about it, and that is the worst of it.
{faction} will be in touch. They won't be.
job: I have a hold of {cargo}, {tonnes} t of it, needing to get from {system} to {destination}, by someone who can be trusted.
There is a run: {tonnes} t of {cargo}, {system} to {destination}. It's more important than the pay suggests.
{tonnes} t of {cargo} from {system} to {destination}. We don't ask many people to do this.
Take {tonnes} t of {cargo} to {destination}. The people receiving it matter more than the goods.
room: Do this and you are among friends. Fail and you've never met us.
Consider this an audition. We pay well for auditions.
We don't advertise. That is why you are hearing it in person.

success: The {cargo} was taken up in the dark by someone you never saw. {faction} pays {reward}.
The buyer left {reward} in an unmarked case and was gone before you looked up.

You waited for the buyer at {system} and they never came. {faction} writes it off.

Some of my clients are strange, and this one is stranger.
